name: 挂机手游模拟器
detailed_description:
Idle Pay-to-Win Mobile Game Simulator
Ever dreamed of experiencing the thrill of popular idle pay - to - win mobile games without spending real money? Idle Pay - to - Win Mobile Game Simulator is the perfect fit for you!

No need for actual recharges. You can still enjoy the pay - to - win - level excitement of skyrocketing combat power and full - screen item drops. Enter redemption codes like VIP666 and VIP777 at the start, and luxurious gifts will be yours instantly for a smooth - sailing, thrilling gameplay!

It not only immersively simulates the exciting gameplay of idle mobile games but also precisely captures the core experience of “your time is extremely valuable”. It's a great way to relax and start an addictive idle journey anytime. Come and experience it on Steam right away!

Core Gameplay Highlights

1. Simulate Real - Player Competition and Recreate Mobile Game Ecosystem

  • World BOSS and Competitive Ranking: Challenge the World BOSS, strive for a high rank in the competition, and fight for rare resources. It reproduces the intense sense of player competition in pay - to - win mobile games 1:1, letting you experience the most authentic “mobile game ecosystem” and see who can dominate the leaderboard!

2. Skyrocketing Combat Power + Map Looting, Full of Excitement

  • Rocket - like Combat Power Surge: No need for in - game purchases. Achieve a crazy breakthrough in combat power through strategic combinations and cultivating spirit beings. The 数值 growth with red numbers flashing all over the screen will fully immerse you in the excitement!

  • Map Looting + Idle Sweeping: Monsters drop abundant items. After clearing specific levels, you can “sweep the map”. Even when idling, you can collect rewards regularly! The higher the level, the more amazing the rewards. Who can resist the feeling of collecting resources while relaxing?

3. Summon Spirit Beings + Combine Synergies, Full of Strategy and Nostalgia

  • Summon Ancient and Modern Spirit Beings: Gather ancient Chinese spirit beings to fight side by side! From Guan Yu and Zhao Yun of the Three Kingdoms, Wu Song and Yan Qing of the Water Margin, Yang Jian and Nezha of myths, to Zhang Liang, Xiang Yu, and Hua Mulan in history... So many classic figures will evoke your nostalgia!

  • Combine Synergies + Strengthen and Cultivate: Different spirit beings can trigger exclusive synergy effects when combined. Strengthen and upgrade the spirit beings to create your own “overpowered team”. Strategic combinations determine the upper limit of your combat effectiveness!

4. Array Assistance + Exciting Lottery, Multi - dimensional Gameplay Expansion

  • Nine Types of Arrays, Strategize: There are 9 types of arrays with different effects built - in. Switch arrays according to different enemies and “arrange troops and deploy formations” to achieve miraculous combat results, maximizing the strategic depth!

  • Exciting Lottery, Everyone Can Be a Lucky Dog: Want to draw prizes but afraid of “going bankrupt from recharges”? Here, lottery tickets can be obtained for free by “grinding”! Enter WOSHIDALAO (I'm the Boss) at the start and get 100 free draws directly! Everyone can be a “lottery lucky dog” and enjoy the treatment of a boss as soon as you log in!

5. Research Technologies + Infinite New Games, Super Replayable

  • 68 Types of Technologies, Free Research: There are 4 categories and 68 researchable technologies designed. Whether you want to focus on “maximizing drop rates” (full - screen drops in the later stage, one monster drops a full set of items), “fast - paced combat clearance” (clear levels quickly and get a head start in the next new game), or “idle and win” (strengthen idle rewards, a delight for lazy players), there's always a technology suitable for your playstyle!

  • Infinite New Games, More Fun Each Time: All gameplay progress (tasks, kills, equipment, collections, lottery times...) will be converted into “start - up points” and inherited to the next new game after clearing the current one! Use the points to directly start the “high - speed level - clearing mode”, clearing one level per second and skipping the development stage. Each new game is a “peak start”, and the more you play, the more enjoyable it gets. Your combat power will always be on the “road to becoming overpowered”!

6. Collect Collections + Upgrade Artifacts, In - depth Cultivation

  • Collect Collections, Strategize to Defeat Enemies: Each monster has unique skills. Collect collections to “know yourself and your enemies”, and combine lineups, synergies, and arrays to achieve “victory in every battle”, a paradise for strategy lovers!

  • Upgrade Artifacts, Forge Divine Equipment: As a spirit master, you can upgrade artifacts to forge equipment of 10 major qualities and infinite levels, with attribute stats maxed out! Each point of “luck attribute” can also increase the monster drop rate, making “full - screen drops” easily achievable. The excitement of cultivation and looting is doubled!
